param(

}

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ExcelPath)) {

	exit 1
}

function Normalize-Name([string]$s) {
	if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($s)) { return "" }
	$s = $s.Trim().ToLower()
	$s = $s.Replace(" ", "").Replace("_", "").Replace("-", "").Replace(".", "")
	return $s
}

function Find-Col($headers, [string[]]$aliases) {
	for ($i = 0; $i -lt $headers.Count; $i++) {
		$n = Normalize-Name $headers[$i]
		foreach ($a in $aliases) {
			if ($n -eq (Normalize-Name $a)) { return $i + 1 }
		}
	}
	return 0
}

function Sql-N([string]$s) {
	if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($s)) { return "null" }
	$t = $s.Replace("'", "''").Trim()
	if ($t.Length -eq 0) { return "null" }
	return "N'$t'"
}

function Sql-Date($v) {
	if ($v -eq $null -or $v -eq "") { return "null" }
	if ($v -is [datetime]) { return "Cast(N'" + $v.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") + "' As date)" }
	$d = $null
	if ([datetime]::TryParse($v.ToString(), [ref]$d)) {
		return "Cast(N'" + $d.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") + "' As date)"
	}
	return "null"
}

function Sql-Bit($v, $default) {
	if ($v -eq $null -or $v -eq "") { return $default }
	$s = Normalize-Name ($v.ToString())
	if ($s -in @("1", "true", "x", "co", "yes", "y")) { return "1" }
	if ($s -in @("0", "false", "khong", "no", "n")) { return "0" }
	return $default
}

$wb = $excel.Workbooks.Open($ExcelPath)
$ws = $wb.Worksheets.Item(1)
$used = $ws.UsedRange

function Cell($r, $c) {

}
